facts: CSP partners must pass business verification and annual vetting.
The indirect model requires active Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program membership, authority to sign legal agreements, and a relationship with an authorized distributor.
The CSP page concerns the Microsoft cloud sales channel and is not proof of rights for the perpetual Office/Windows items in this pilot.
Bitdefender publishes a Partner Advantage Network reselling partner program.
The official process states sign-up, company profile creation, product discovery and use of the distribution system.
The existence of the program is not proof that DIGITALSOFT/LicenzPol is enrolled or authorized.

sources.authority: Court of Justice of the European Union
sources.fact: The judgment is relevant to exhaustion of certain software distribution rights, but it does not substitute for a product-specific chain of title, original license terms, proof of first sale in the EEA, or proof that the prior acquirer's copy was made unusable.

microsoft: Executed reseller/distributor agreement or product-specific EEA chain-of-title documents
Supplier invoice identifying the exact edition and license type
License terms and transfer eligibility for each unit
Proof that the supplied identifiers are assigned to the exact offer
bitdefender: Partner Advantage Network acceptance or authorized distributor agreement
Supplier invoice/order identifying product, seats/devices and term
Proof that activation codes originate from the authorized channel

decision: Public web research identifies legitimate onboarding routes but cannot create or prove LicenzPol's contractual authorization. Provenance remains unverified for all pilot products.
